_doc: Module -> release_gate.ps1 steps (arch024 PLAN (c) c-1). Read by `release_gate.ps1 -Module <name>` (step selection),
tools/gates/modules_check.py (validation against a tree and the gate's step list) and tools/impact/impact.py
(which modules a diff touches).
STATUS: DEV-TIME FAST FEEDBACK ONLY. Not for releases, rc merges or bug-fix releases until the owner signs
off O1 and O2 (arch024 PLAN, sign-off list). Until then a release / rc / bug-fix release runs the full
release_gate.ps1 on both GPUs under the current bug-fix rules (docs/dev/testing.md).
Fields: id (PLAN module id); paths (globs, repo-relative, '/' separators; a diff file matching one belongs to
the module); lands_on (the branch / step that adds the module's files: when no path matches a file in the
tree, the module is 'declared, not on this branch' instead of an error); steps (release_gate step names; one
GPU = run the gate on one card, two = both cards one after the other); pending (steps a later arch024 step
adds to release_gate: printed, not run, never silently dropped; an entry here whose step already exists in
the gate is an error, so the list is cleaned when the step lands); manual (checks outside release_gate,
printed for the runner); when (extra steps when a named file changes); full (the full gate on both GPUs);
callers: "rdeps" = also run the modules of every src/include file that includes the module's files (transitive;
an includer in no module = the full gate), or a list of module names (review A4). release_gate prints, and
impact.py adds as -Steps, the steps the impact map selects beyond this table (PLAN c-2).
Every step name must exist in release_gate.ps1 -List or be in pending, else release_gate exits 2.
status: dev-only: not for releases until owner sign-off O1/O2 (arch024 PLAN)

_doc: measure-tools P3 PROPOSAL (mt-p3, 2026-10-25; not enforced: the judge is P6, the release integration P7). Per module:
the component metrics of whirl-host-bench (tests/bench/host_bench.cpp) and how a new run is judged. NO measured
numbers here (memory data-never-to-github): baselines live in internal_docs/results.db (view v_component_baseline,
key metric + cell + gpu + code_hash + settings_key). Rules: work = the per-cell work row (copies / bytes by
direction, syncs, allocs, pages) compared EXACTLY with the stored row of the same key (a difference = the change
altered what the component does: explain it or it is a defect); time = median ns per op judged against the stored
distribution: with < 30 stored rows, OUT only when median_new > median_base + max(3 * MAD_base, rel) in two runs
with the order swapped (A B, B A; whirl-bench-check order rule); rel = the per-module 'rel' below; else the 95 %
interval of the stored rows. One of 6 CPU runs can be a whole-run outlier (+30..140 % on several cells, 2026-10-25):
a single run never calls OUT. Budgets are relative to stored end-to-end numbers (looked up, never written here).
CPU rows (backend null) are labelled cpu-only and keyed by the machine; never compared across machines.

handles.rel: 10% (4 KiB alloc: one outlier run of 6 at +64 %: needs 2 runs to call OUT)
must: NullBackend clean() at exit (no live allocation / stream / event)

ckpt_store.work: exact (copies and bytes per save / load = the checkpoint layout)
ckpt_store.gpu: tier.copy.d2d_gbps at the checkpoint size (whirl-host-bench-hip --suite copy) per GPU

page_pool.work: exact (pages per request = ceil(tok / kv_page); cow = one page copy per pool array)
page_pool.budget: ensure_unref at the slot context <= 1 % of the stored prefill time of that length on the faster GPU

prefix_store.work: none (host only; the reuse value of cache_match is part of the selftest)
prefix_store.budget: pick_slot at 16 slots x 128k <= 1 % of the stored TTFT of a 128k prefix-reuse request

tier_bridge.work: exact (spill: span bytes = checkpoints + pages x page_bytes)
tier_bridge.rel: 5% restore_match, 15% spill_new (memmove of the whole entry; CPU baseline run-to-run range 6-15%, one 58% run at 128k)
tier_bridge.gpu: pinned h2d / d2h GB/s by size and queue depth per GPU (R9700 over USB4, 8060S UMA: separate keys)

protocol.work: exact (no device work beyond the engine's)

engine_gov.note: no host-bench suite yet (governor decisions are event driven); counters only via whirl-server-tests governor*

threads.budget: engine host time per decode cycle (MockModel, free forward) <= 1 % of the fastest stored decode ms per token
threads.noise: see sched: OS thread wake-up bound, judge by paired in-session A/B only

sched.work: exact per round (MockModel, mtp off, greedy, ignore_eos: deterministic)
sched.noise: mt-p3 CPU baseline: run-to-run range 30-113 % over 6 runs (normal priority no better): request time is bound by thread wake-ups (HTTP / engine loop), not by the engine code; a time verdict needs a paired A/B in one session; the work row is the contract
sched.budget: round_us_per_cycle <= 1 % of the fastest stored decode ms per token (results_query 'decode R9700')
